cim: COP31’s Antalya AI Pledge to tackle artificial intelligence’s climate footprint
cim_eredeti: COP31’s Antalya AI Pledge to tackle artificial intelligence’s climate footprint
szoveg_eredeti:
​​​​The COP31 Presidency and the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) officially launched the Antalya Artificial Intelligence Pledge, a key moment in the global effort to align AI innovation with climate action. Backed by an initial coalition of governments, companies, research institutions, and civil society organizations, the pledge recognizes the dual implications of AI—as both a powerful tool for addressing climate challenges and a growing source of environmental pressure due to its own energy demand and resource consumption. Signatories commit to measurable actions aligned with internationally recognized standards for AI systems, based on low- and zero- emission power as well as sustainable infrastructure. ITU and the COP31 Presidency are now calling on stakeholders worldwide to join this collective effort to advance climate-conscious AI.
